notes: §1985:X.5.2.4 GR14: if BY CONTENT 'is specified or implied for a parameter, the called program cannot change the value of this parameter as referenced in the CALL statement's USING phrase, though the called program may change the value of the data item referenced by the corresponding data-name', the descriptions to be 'the same, meaning no conversion or extension or truncation' (a requirement on the source). CallBinder.BindCall carries BY CONTENT across the following parameters (GR12), CallEmitter.ArgCarrierText/CallContentRead snapshot the value at the CALL into a detached cell and ProgramEmitter.FormalCrossing lands it in the formal, so the callee's stores stay local; Format1Narrowing refuses the 2002 literal/figurative/BY VALUE/OMITTED forms at 85. Probes: (b) implied BY CONTENT after the phrase (Z0 kept 0 though the callee moved 7), BY CONTENT W BY REFERENCE W (caller sees only the reference store), literal, ZERO, BY VALUE, OMITTED, empty phrase refused; (a/d/f) S9(18), COMP-3, edited, an ODO group whose count the callee changed, TE(I) with I changed by the callee; (e) failed CALL takes ON OVERFLOW. Sibling already filed: BY CONTENT FUNCTION UPPER-CASE accepted at 85 (§1985:X.5.2.3 SR4, kb/Work PB5129). The witness prints AAAAA/CCCCC/BBBBB/DDDDD/AAAAA/CCCCC/SSSSS.

next.reason: 1985: with BY CONTENT 'the called program cannot change the value of this parameter as referenced in the CALL statement USING phrase' though it may change its own formal item, and the descriptions 'must be the same, meaning no conversion or extension or truncation'. The protection is kept: §2023:14.2.3 GR9 allocates a record that 'does not occupy the same storage area as the argument', and §2023:14.9.4.3 SR4 makes such an identifier-2 'a sending operand'. Conformance is looser: §2023:14.8.2.3.3 needs only 'the formal parameter shall be of the same length as the corresponding argument' for an elementary item in a plain CALL (COMPUTE/SET/MOVE rules otherwise), and §2023:14.8.2.2 SR2 applies MOVE rules to a group. §2023:13.7.3 SR3 and §2023:14.9.4.3 SR25 apply them, and §2023:14.9.4.4 GR3d sets EC-PROGRAM-ARG-MISMATCH on a detected violation.
